name: Dead hauler
text: A bulk hauler drifts with its running lights still on. Nobody answers. The cargo doors are open, which is either good news or very bad news.

outcomes.result: The crew comes back with a crate of parts and a few things nobody asks about.
A pressure door gives on the way out. Someone will feel it tomorrow, but the crate came too.

choices.label: Grab what's loose
choices.result: Loose change and canned food from the galley. Nobody gets hurt.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.result: Some things are best left drifting.
